text:
Anjali: Hey infra team — onboarding two new tenant accounts that need GPU capacity in us-west-3 and eu-south-2. Requesting p5 + g5 instance quota lifts and ENI count checks. Account IDs: 987654321000, 987654321001. Can someone own the AWS support ticket?

Marc: I can pick this up. Quick q: do we need p4d as well or just p5/g5 for these tenants?

Anjali: For the initial run, p5 + g5 only. We'll add p4d later if latency-sensitive training spikes.

Toby: Noted. Two things to check: per-region "GPU instance" quota + "Network interfaces per instance" (ENI) and VPC subnet IP capacity. eu-south-2 sometimes has low ENI-per-VPC defaults.

Sophie: Also confirm whether they want reserved capacity (Dedicated) vs shared hosted. If reserved, we should open a capacity reservation ask to avoid cold-start capacity issues.

Marc: I'll open the AWS support case and start the quota requests. Drafting the request now. Will link the case here once created.

Marc: Filing case — created support case #12345678901 with AWS. Summary: "Quota increase: p5/g5 instances and ENI limits for accounts 987654321000/987654321001 in us-west-3 and eu-south-2".

InfraBot: Support case created: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=12345678901 (automated) :gear:

Nikhil: Heads up — cost note: p5 usage in eu-south-2 is ~2.4x cost compared to us-west-2 on our billing experiments. If tenant wants predictable spend, recommend enabling autoscaling + spot fallback.

Anjali: Good call. For now we want baseline dedicated throughput, but config will include spot pools for non-critical batches.

Toby: Marc — when you file the quota asks, include this CLI snippet (AWS Service Quotas) so CSR can action faster: 
```
aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-7A35A5E3 --desired-value 50 --region eu-south-2
```
Replace quota-code with GPU instance types and ENI quota codes per region.

Marc: Yep using that. Also adding this note into the case: subnet IP planning needs /22 minimum per GPU pool to avoid ENI exhaustion when scaling.

Sophie: Can we add a quick runbook step to the tenant onboarding checklist to validate subnet sizes and route tables? We keep hitting weird ENI limits during scale tests.

Anjali: Yes — ticket opened in infra-runbooks: https://internal.redwood/d/infra-runbooks/gpu-onboard (please add checklist item).

Marc: AWS replied requesting expected sustained vCPU/GPU hours and projected peak concurrency. I uploaded our traffic profile + expected qps.

InfraBot: AWS support updated case #12345678901: "Additional review required — provide workload profile and expected scaling patterns".

Nikhil: I pushed a short CSV with hourly GPU-hour forecast for next 90 days to the case. File: gpu-forecast-90d.csv.

Toby: Once AWS confirms quotas, we should pre-provision an EC2 Capacity Reservation (or placement group) for the first 48h of onboarding to avoid spot cold starts. Who signs off on the reservation cost?

Sophie: Product ok to cover initial 48h reservations for customer-facing onboards. Keep finance in the loop if reservation > $10k/day.

Anjali: Thanks. Marc — assign follow-ups: 1) Track AWS case to resolution, 2) Update onboarding runbook with subnet/ENI checklist, 3) Create a short cost play explaining reserved vs spot for tenant.

Marc: Assigned and will update here. ETA: EOD tomorrow for runbook draft, AWS case pending.

InfraBot: Reminder: Please tag @oncall if quota change impacts production.

Toby: FYI added a quick verification script to ensure ENI headroom after quotas applied:
```
#!/bin/bash
REGION=eu-south-2
ACCOUNT=987654321000
aws ec2 describe-account-attributes --region $REGION | grep max-enis
```
Run after AWS confirms.

Anjali: Perfect. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

Marc: AWS case updated — they provisionally approved p5/g5 increases pending region capacity confirmation. Asked for approval to do a capacity check with the regional team.

Sophie: Keep me posted. I want a short note for the tenant about expected latency while we wait on region confirmation.

Anjali: Will draft tenant message once we have firm approval.

Marc: Final note — added a short cost estimate into the case and linked the PR that creates the Infra Terraform module for new GPU pools: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/terraform/pulls/456

Toby: Nice. Once quotas land I'll run the smoke test and ping this thread.

Anjali: Closing loop later — thanks all.
